test_title: SSC CGL 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On : 08 Dec 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.

Someone’s heart is in the right place

options.text: Suddenly feel so excited or frightened that your heart beats faster
Change your opinion or the way you feel
Share secret worries with someone else
Someone is good even if they sometimes behave in a wrong manner

solution:
The correct answer is 'Someone is good even if they sometimes behave in a wrong manner'.
